title: The extraction pipeline and what it costs
question: How does a guide's web page become picks on the site, and where does the model spend go?

tldr.text: Daily cron fetches every guide; only changed pages reach a model
Two paid calls per changed guide: Sonnet extracts, Opus verifies
Measured: about $0.30–0.40 per changed guide; $2.41–$7.69 a day
Quote checks and holds are plain code: no model, no cost
Moving to the subscription swaps only `makeClient`; all else stays

highlights.title: Runs daily at 6am Pacific
highlights.body: Every guide is checked once a day. Most days only 10–19 of 112 have a changed page, so most cost nothing.

highlights.title: Calls the `bb refresh` CLI
highlights.body: The cloud run uses the API key secret. Local runs use the same command from your machine.

highlights.title: Clean runs merge themselves
highlights.body: A run with no `review` lines and exit 0 auto-merges. Anything held, shrunk, or flagged waits for you.

highlights.title: At most 20 extractions a run
highlights.body: Caps a bad day at roughly $8–10. Guides past the cap are deferred to the next run.

highlights.at: pages.push({ source: { url, fetched }, stored, path: p, gate: pageGate(
highlights.title: Fetch, then gate each page
highlights.body: Compares new page text to the stored copy before spending anything.

highlights.title: No relevant change: $0
highlights.body: Dates and banners don't count. About half the guides stop here every day.

highlights.title: Over budget: deferred
highlights.body: The page isn't stored, so tomorrow's run sees it as changed and extracts it then.

highlights.at: const { output, usage } = await extract(deps.client, ballot, guide, sources);
highlights.title: Paid call 1: extract
highlights.body: Sonnet reads the whole page and the guide's ballot. Most of each guide's cost is this input.

highlights.title: Big drop in picks: stop
highlights.body: A suspicious shrink keeps the old file and skips verify, so you pay for extract only.

highlights.at: const v = await verify(deps.client, ballot, guide, audited, sources);
highlights.title: Paid call 2: verify
highlights.body: Runs only when picks changed or a verifier hold exists. Costs about twice extract per token.

highlights.title: Prices behind the estimate
highlights.body: Dollars per million tokens. Cache reads are 10x cheaper than input, which is why the system prompt is cached.

highlights.title: HTTP first, browser if needed
highlights.body: Free, but a 403 or a timeout fails the guide for the day. Those go to the local refresh.

highlights.title: The free filter
highlights.body: Only a change that touches the ballot's names or measures counts as `relevant`.

highlights.title: Sonnet with a cached system prompt
highlights.body: The ballot prompt is cached across guides with the same areas. The page itself is new input each time.

highlights.title: Extract model
highlights.body: Sonnet 5.5 at $2 in, $10 out per million tokens.

highlights.at: const verified = verifyQuotes(p.quotes.slice(0, MAX_QUOTES), pages, { ownNames });
highlights.title: Every quote checked in code
highlights.body: A quote must appear word for word on the page and stand alone. Failing ones are dropped for free.

highlights.title: Word-for-word match
highlights.body: No model involved. This is why a provider swap can't loosen quote accuracy.

highlights.title: Opus audits the picks
highlights.body: Re-reads the pages at high effort. $4 in, $20 out per million: the priciest step per token.

highlights.title: Doubtful picks become holds
highlights.body: Unconfirmed picks move to `held` and don't show on the site until confirmed or fixed.

highlights.title: Merge into the guide's file
highlights.body: Keeps holds, rejected quotes, and the date of the last real change.

highlights.at: return new Anthropic({ apiKey, authToken: null, baseURL: "https://api.anthropic.com" });
highlights.title: Where the bill goes
highlights.body: Every call above runs through this one client. Swapping it for a `claude -p` client moves spend to your subscription.

highlights.title: The swap point
highlights.body: Anything with `messages.stream` works. The subscription adapter implements this type.

tour.title: A daily cron starts it
tour.body: Once a day the cloud workflow runs `bb refresh` over every guide with the API key.

tour.title: At most 20 paid extractions
tour.body: The budget caps a run at roughly $8–10. Extra changed guides wait a day.

tour.title: Fetch and gate: free
tour.body: Each page is fetched and compared to its stored copy. Unchanged guides stop here at $0.

tour.title: Paid call 1: Sonnet extracts
tour.body: The whole page goes to Sonnet with a cached ballot prompt. Extract plus verify averages $0.30–0.40.

tour.title: Quotes checked in code
tour.body: Every quote must appear word for word and stand alone. No model, no cost.

tour.title: Paid call 2: Opus verifies
tour.body: Only when picks changed. Opus re-reads the pages and holds anything it can't confirm.

tour.title: Merge, then open the PR
tour.body: Holds and rejected quotes survive. A clean run merges itself; anything flagged waits for you.

tour.title: One client pays for it all
tour.body: Both paid calls go through this client. The subscription adapter replaces just this.
